title: Haye Haye Ali Asghar (As)
body:
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
Kehte The Ye Shabbir Lahu Chehre Pe Mal Kar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
1: Chota Hai Bahot Tera Gala Teer Bada Hai.
Aada Ne Tuje Zabh'a Nahi Naher Kiya Hai.
Ay Mere Guletar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
2: Muskaan Labo'n Par Thi Tere Teer Ke Aage.
Naize Pa Jo Dekhega Rida Maa'n Ke Dulhaare.
Roega Tera Sar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
3) Nanha Sa Tera Sar Bhi Chadhaenge Sina Par.
Fekenge Sabhi Kholta Pani Kabhi Patthar.
Ye Dushmane Haider.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
4)Is Jalti Hui Khaak Me Gar Tujko Chupaya.
Garmi Se Badan Tera Na Gaal Jaye Ay Beta.
Lagta Hai Muje Dar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
5): Sukhi Hui Gardan Se Abhi Khoon Rawa,n Hain.
Or Pusht Pe Chaalo'n Ke Nisha,n Khushk Zaba,n Hai.
Kaisa Hai Ye Manzar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
6) Tuti Hui Gardan Se Teri Khun Ka Bhena.
Dekhegi Jo Is Haal Me Maa'n Tujko Ay Beta.
Mar Jayegi Madar.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
7): Dekhu'n Mai Jawa'n Hote Tumhe Tha Mera Arma'n.
Lekin Mere In Khwab Ki Duniya Hui Weera'n.
Ab ky karo jee kar .
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
8) Ye Zul'm Yahi'n Par To Nahi'n Rokenge Aada.
Naizo'n Se Niqalenge Tera Qab'r Se Laasha.
Katenge Tera Sar.
Haye Haye Ali Asghar
9) Puchegi Sakina Kya Pila Laye Ho Pani.
Kya Jaa Ke Bataunga Use Ran Ki Kahani.
Kuchto Kaho Dilbaar
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
10): Abbas O Haqeer Aaqa Sare Khaima Jab Aaye.
Lashe Ko Rakha Khaak Pa Kuch Keh Nahi Paye.
Bas Ye Tha Labo'n Par.
Haye Haye Ali Asgar.
